title: A New SOTA for Browser Agents: Ramain Leads Four Major Benchmarks
summary: Ramain reaches state-of-the-art performance on Online-Mind2Web, WebVoyager, WorkArena L3, and WebArena-Verified Hard.
body_markdown:
## The model is not the whole product


We use efficient context management and an optimized browser representation to improve reliability. These techniques squeeze more value from every token and push performance beyond what frontier models alone can buy.


In practice, these results mean Ramain can navigate the vast majority of interfaces and reliably carry out multi-step tasks unaided. Accuracy is only the first production constraint, though. Browser agents consume a significant number of tokens, so cost-efficiency decides which workflows are practical to automate.
